title: SuperPipeline check.failed
description: A check on a card's arrival at a stage failed, and the card went back to returnedTo (charter 2026-11-09, a gate may be decided by checks). One per failed check. Mirrors SuperPipeline's CheckFailedBody (apps/api/src/board/views.ts). Readers ignore properties they do not know.

boardId.description: Null only on a board not yet initialised; a carrier needs it to route the event.

arrivalId.description: The card's arrival at the stage this check belongs to: one per arrival, so a carrier says each once.

returnedTo.description: The stage the card went back to; null when it could not go back and waits for a person.
